items.name: Rainbow Machine
items.howToUse: You put in 25 Gold brainrots in it
items.whatItDoes: It will start the rainbow event giving brainrots a higher chance for Rainbow mutation

items.name: Bubblegum Machine
items.howToUse: You put 10 Candy brainrots in it
items.whatItDoes: It will activate and it can give the Bubblegum trait to brainrots
items.inGameRightNow: Yes, but only if Sammy activates it. and you do not have put 10 Candy brainrots in it as it would be filled.

items.name: Fuse Machine
items.whatItDoes: It can give you one brainrot and that brainrot has a chance to get the traits or mutation from the 4 brainrots you put it in. It's by chance/luck.

items.name: Craft Machine
items.howToUse: You put 2-4 brainrots in it, depending on the recipe.
items.whatItDoes: You can craft a brainrot with a 100% chance of getting, but it required the brainrots for the recipe.

items.name: Witch Fuse
items.whatItDoes: It can give you one brainrot and that brainrot has a chance to get the traits or mutation from the 4 brainrots you put it in. It's by chance/luck.

items.name: Brainrot Dealer
items.howToUse: You spend the in game cash
items.whatItDoes: You can buy brainrots and it will spawn with a 100% chance, but only if the brainrot was in stock.

items.name: Brainrot Trader
items.howToUse: You put 1-5 brainrots in it, depending on the recipe.
items.whatItDoes: You can trade for a brainrot with a 100% chance of getting, but it required the brainrots for the recipe.

items.name: Santa's Fuse
items.whatItDoes: It can give you one brainrot and that brainrot has a chance to get the traits or mutation from the 4 brainrots you put it in. It's by chance/luck.

items.name: Santa's Shop
items.howToUse: You spend the in game gold elves or robux
items.whatItDoes: It will give you a brainrot if you buy it with robux or gold elves. but only if the brainrot was in stock.

items.name: New Year's Machine
items.howToUse: You put brainrots that is brainrot god rarity or higher in it
items.whatItDoes: It will start the New Years Event and also spawn a 2026 brainrot

items.name: Cupid's Machine
items.howToUse: Insert a specific combination of Two Brainrots to get a different reward.
items.whatItDoes: 45% Heart Lucky Block 40.25% Nothing 14.50% Cupid Cupid Sahur 0.25% Lovin Rose 0.0625% Love Love Bear

items.name: Trade Machine
items.howToUse: You choose brainrot(s) to trade with the other player, and press accept after all players have pressed ready, and once all players have pressed accept, the brainrot the other player had will go into your base, same with the other one.

items.name: Divine Fuse
items.whatItDoes: It can give you one brainrot and that brainrot has a chance to get the traits or mutation from the 4 brainrots you put it in. It's by chance/luck.

items.name: Egg Incubator
items.howToUse: You put Egg Lucky Blocks in it
items.whatItDoes: You can still get traits even if it's not on the track.

items.name: Cyber Craft Machine
items.howToUse: You put specific Brainrots to craft another specific Brainrot
items.whatItDoes: Once you give it the required Brainrots, it will start crafting for a certain amount of time (the better the Brainrot the longer it takes). Once the timer is over (or Sammy skips the craft timer), you can reveal the Brainrot.
